author: Oprativsatoshi21
body: First starters my in game name is Oprativsatoshi21, and i would like to be unbanned for i was banned for ban evading. Which is not as true i put in chat my alt got banned for hacks, my alternate account was cadenb578 which at the time was my bestfriends account and he no longer had interest in minecraft anymore. So he gave me his account which i called my alt and as time passed by his account got hacked and a person changed his password. I had thought that his account got banned on avicus as the person who hacked it was a hacker and in doing so i got banned for ban evading which is not true because i have not done anything wrong the cadenb578 account was not banned but, i am banned for ban evading when i have not done anything wrong, i have alot of infractions such as swearing cussing and team spleefing but, i was a little kid at the time and i have grown up and realized that the thing i did were some what child like and i would appreciate to be unbanned as it has been almost 2 years since i have been banned from the server which i still think of as the best minecraft server. I would say i have waited long enough to get unbanned because it has been almost a year i have been around since 1.5.2 and i was 13 maybe 12 at the time i was immature and thought i'd be funny to swear but seeing it now i will behave and i am sorry for ban evading which i didn't think i did entirely because my friends account got hacked and got his ign changed but, yet i had to suffer the consequences not the person. if you look up on youtube Cadenb578 you will see hacker videos of him that is not me i have my own personal youtube opratiS21 which is me fully and caden is my friend who got his account hacked please i apologize for ever being a disruption all i ask is to be unbanned from the server i started playing minecraft on :/ .
